Prologue:
Welcome to 'The True
Tale of the Xiake',
a brand-new RPG from
Chunlan Studio! It's
a raising sim with
free stat allocation
and an age system,
and the whole game
changes as your
character levels up.
So that you learn
something while
playing, all NPC
dialogue is famous
sayings, so read
them carefully! One
last secret tip:
when you play Xiake,
use Pickpocket a
lot. Also, finding
the hidden storyline
at the start makes
the game a bit
easier~ That's all.
Have fun!
